thread:
rhea: Kicking off a tiny least-priv canary next Wed. Objective: validate rollback path and artifact packaging for auditors. Keeping it to 3 projects.
omar: +1. Plan: dry-run report -> evidence pack -> canary with infra guard -> verify smoke tests -> full run.
leah: Need explicit KMS safety step. Before any removal: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy $KEY --format=json > $KEY-iam.json` and sha256 it. If any service account references key in logs, skip.
chris: I'll add an infra-agent flag `--fail-deploy-on-missing-role` for the canary. When enabled, deploys referencing a removed role fail with clear remediation link.
leah: Also include `repo-scan` to catch IaC references (terraform state / repos). If found, open owner ticket instead of pruning.
rhea: Evidence format: one signed tarball per principal containing binding snapshot, KMS/key policy, bucket ACLs, notification snippets, `prune-record.txt`, manifest.sha256, and a detached GPG sig. Legal OK?
audit-bot: AuditBot: Created task PV-5234 "privilege-canary evidence & rollback" assigned to rhea, leah.
ops-oncall: Ops: we'll run the 3-project canary Wed 02:00 UTC, enable guard, collect traces to /var/log/priv-canary/5234 for 48h, and run CI smoke tests. If smoke tests fail, we'll call `rebind-temp --principal $P --ttl 1h --reason "auto-rollback"`. That action will be recorded and signed.
omar: Recovery note: `rebind-temp` should both add binding and generate a signed change artifact that's uploaded to the same compliance bucket. Make it scriptable and idempotent.
chris: CI: will auto-run smoke, trigger `rebind-temp` on failure, and open P0 with logs. I'll post PR for the guard flag and test tomorrow.
leah: I'll prepare snapshot+pack script: exports, sha256 manifest, tar, gpg sign, upload to s3://compliance-archive/pv-5234/. Will also grep logs for recent KMS accesses and include that log extract in the tarball.
rhea: Action items: chris infra guard PR, leah snapshot script + uploads, omar repo-scan rule, ops run canary Wed 02:00 UTC. Post PR/ticket links here and attach artifact checksums to PV-5234. Keep updates short. :thumbsup:
